description: On October 29, 2026, Binance suffered a record $6.3 billion hack that triggered $1.57 billion in liquidations and sent Bitcoin to a six-week low. Tether froze $1.5 billion while Binance moved quickly to cover 95% of losses and resume customer withdrawals.
